references.disposition: Categorical monicity is quantified over every source object; it is not defined by elementwise injectivity in arbitrary categories.

review_rationale: Read a monomorphism as left-cancellable under composition from an arbitrary source W in a category; preserved orientation f∘a=f∘b and avoided assuming set-level injectivity.
